item.title: International Visitors Say No to GMO Release In New Zealand - Survey
item.description: ENVIRONMENT A survey of international visitors shows that two thirds believe New Zealand should keep GMO crops and animals out of the environment.The survey conducted with International tourists from two cruise ships docked in Auckland, asked: "Should New Zealand allow GMO plants and animals into the environment?"74.1% of visitors said No.17.2% said they didn't know.8.7% said Yes.Results are consistent amongst people from 20 countries across Asia, America, Europe and the UK.
